claims.evidence: MaxQuant summary.txt groups the 84 SILAC raw files into six experiments U1..U6 (14 fractions each, Multiplicity 2). Each experiment is one light+heavy mixture of a shUSP9X culture and a shGFP culture (PRIDE protocol), giving one source per (condition, mixture): 12 sources x 14 files.

claims.location: comment[label] + characteristics[genetic modification] + factor value[genetic modification] rows 1-84 (U1-U3)
claims.value: U1, U2, U3 (forward): SILAC light = shRNA targeting USP9X; SILAC heavy = shRNA targeting GFP (control)
claims.evidence: PRIDE sampleProcessingProtocol: "For the forward assays, the stable shUSP9X cell lines were cultured in light media (R0K0) and the stable shGFP cell lines were cultured in heavy media (R10K8). For the reverse assays, the label strategy was reciprocal." Which experiments are forward is not stated; data check on the knockdown target itself: USP9X (Q93008) normalized H/L U1 2.34, U2 4.86, U3 1.27 (>1, i.e. lower in light = knockdown in light). NFX1 (Q12986) H/L 1.68, 2.73, 1.08, consistent with the abstract (USP9X knockdown lowers NFX1-123 protein). Global log2 H/L correlation U1/U2/U3 mutually +0.43..+0.56.

claims.location: comment[label] + characteristics[genetic modification] + factor value[genetic modification] rows 85-168 (U4-U6)
claims.value: U4, U5, U6 (reverse): SILAC heavy = shRNA targeting USP9X; SILAC light = shRNA targeting GFP (control)
claims.evidence: Reciprocal labelling per PRIDE protocol. USP9X normalized H/L U4 0.42, U5 0.17, U6 0.75 (<1 = knockdown in heavy); NFX1 0.60, 0.27, 0.86. Correlation with forward experiments negative: U4 vs U1 -0.80, U5 vs U2 -0.89, U6 vs U3 -0.85; U4/U5/U6 mutually +0.35..+0.54. Three forward + three reverse matches the data-processing text "quantified in at least 3 replicates among forward and reverse assays".

Each SILAC mixture combines one light and one heavy culture; light and heavy cultures of a condition are necessarily separate cultures in forward vs reverse mixtures, and the six mixtures are separate experiments in MaxQuant. Numbering restarts per factor-value group and is unique per mixture culture (README.adoc:330, campaign rule 3). Whether the three forward and three reverse cultures were derived from fewer independent shRNA transductions is not documented (limitation).

claims.value: 1..14 = numeric suffix of the raw file name
claims.evidence: High-pH RP fractionation (PRIDE protocol); 14 files per experiment named _1.._14. MaxQuant summary.txt agrees for U2-U6; for U1 it assigns U1_2->1, U1_3->2, U1_1->3. The file-name order was kept: MS/MS counts show fraction-2 files are the highest in every other experiment (U2_2 55546, U3_2 54042, U4_2 55745, U5_2 54853, U6_2 55870) and U1_2 (55748) behaves the same, so the file name, not the MaxQuant design, looks right. Recorded as limitation.
PRIDE organism NCBITaxon 9606; HeLa is human (Cellosaurus OX 9606).

claims.location: comment[ms2 mass analyzer] + comment[fragment mass tolerance] rows 1-168
claims.evidence: Q Exactive MS2 at resolution 17,500 in the Orbitrap; MaxQuant parameters.txt "MS/MS tol. (FTMS) 20 ppm".
Full MS "Scan range 300 to 1500 m/z" in all 84 SILAC raw files.

PRIDE protocol says only "FASP digestion" without naming the enzyme. MaxQuant searched all 84 files with Enzyme Trypsin/P, Enzyme mode Specific, max 2 missed cleavages, and identified 1,600,782 of 4,348,193 MS/MS (30.35%) and 121,111 peptide sequences at 1% FDR, which only a tryptic digest gives. Search rule Trypsin/P recorded here; digestion enzyme = trypsin (campaign rule 2).

Arg10 = 13C6 15N4 (UNIMOD:267), Lys8 = 13C6 15N2 (UNIMOD:259); MT=Variable per campaign rule 11. Protocol text "R10K8" agrees.

limitations: Publication (J Proteome Res 2019, doi:10.1021/acs.jproteome.9b00139) is closed access; only the abstract was read. Methods come from the PRIDE protocol text, raw headers and the MaxQuant output. Culture medium, reduction/alkylation reagents, passage numbers and storage temperature are therefore not available.

Forward/reverse assignment of U1..U6 is not stated in any text; it is inferred from the deposited ratios of the knockdown target USP9X and the global ratio correlation, under the explicit labelling statement of the PRIDE protocol. The evidence is strong (USP9X H/L 2.3-4.9 vs 0.17-0.42 in four of six; U3 1.27 and U6 0.75 weaker, but anticorrelated -0.85 with each other and matching their group).
Biological replicate numbering assumes each mixture used separate cultures; whether forward and reverse cultures share a parental shRNA transduction is not documented.
Fraction numbering for U1_1..U1_3 follows file names; the MaxQuant design assigned U1_2/U1_3/U1_1 to fractions 1/2/3.
